response.sql:
WITH transaction_trader_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
pairs_with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    transreg,
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM transaction_trader_pairs
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count_per_pair,
  AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share_per_pair
FROM pairs_with_shares
GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: The pair count is computed from advanced behaviour records grouped by transaction and trader type; the distinct transaction count in each pair is then used as the numerator, with the denominator being the sum of those counts across all pairs.
